game.name: Only Up!
game.rules:
## Run

# If you submit a run prior to any Leaderboard changes or ruling stance changes, your run is still considered a valid submission.

- You are **not** allowed to use the Only Up! Trainer or any other software to reset your position to the starting position.  

- The first movement of your run must be the first movement of the game. *Please do at least one of the following: include the loading screen in your video or make sure that the in-game yellow timer at the start is clearly visible and less than 5 sec should have elapsed since the beginning of the game.*

- The use of 3rd party software crosshairs or crosshairs that are enabled through physical equipment on screen (i.e.: monitor crosshair) are allowed **unless** they interfere with the visual recording of the run.

- The use of any speed-up cheat is not allowed.

- You *must* be playing on the 2nd lastest version of the game, the one with the drone,dino... (you can find it in the [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/wkeKBXkFFa)).

- The use of macros are **not** allowed under any circumstance during your run. (Once the timer starts)

- You are **allowed** to remap keys (e.g. jump to scroll wheel)
- You are not allowed to remap unused game action (e.g. Ragdoll action) (except in Any% Unrestricted)

- You are not allowed to use the "Save Progress" elevator (except in Any% Unrestricted)

## Glitches:

If not specified, all categories share the same restrictions regarding glitches as the Any% All Skips category.

Double champagne is **allowed** to perform **only** at **30 fps** unless its specified to not use in certain gategory.

Glitches such as roll boost, grabbing falling platforms and LFly are only allowed in Any% Unrestricted.

## Timing:

Timers are not *required* on screen to submit a run. (But appreciated)

If not specified, the timing starts when you make the first move (from the starting position) and ends at the first frame the final cinematic plays.

Timings are real-time, meaning that *pauses* and the use of *slow-motion* do not subtract from your total completion time.

You can omit milliseconds when submitting your runs. We will precisely retime runs if needed.

## Video Requirements:

- Don't submit an entire VOD of a live (Twitch, YouTube, Kick)
- Entire run in one segment
- Either one of: clearly audible game audio or no fps drop or "freeze" at any point (both would be appreciated)
- Recording with your phone is allowed for submission, but the full recording but not be split in anyway, as well as the full coverage of the game must be in the recording.
- 3rd party software crosshairs (ex: Steam, etc) are allowed **unless** they interfere with the visual recording of the run.

categories.name: Tournament Qualification%
categories.rules:
## *For category rules please refer to the category rules of "any% dragon route"*

•It's important to note that the ranking is still based on Any% Dragon Route. The temporary leaderboard serves only to distinguish results achieved during a live stream for final qualification purposes.

•When submitting their personal best times, runners should still prioritize Any% Dragon Route. When a runner realizes their time meets the qualification requirements and they intend to participate, they should manually submit to the temporary leaderboard "Tournament Qualification%".

•The final list of participants for the finals will be determined by the official announcement.

## **Qualifcation requirements**

• Achieving a legitimate top 16 ranking in the SRC official Only Up! Any% Dragon Route leaderboard during a **live stream** grants qualification to the finals.

• Existing eligible results from the Only Up! Any% Dragon Route leaderboard will be transferred to the qualification leaderboard by the admin team after obtaining the runners' consent. Participants do not need to resubmit; submitting to the temporary leaderboard signifies the runner's intention to participate.

## **Tournament Details**

### • Semifinals:

Semifinal Grouping: The 16 qualified runners will be divided into two groups, A and B, for the semifinals based on their rankings. The grouping for the semifinals is as follows (numbers represent seed player numbers):

Group A: 1, 4, 5, 8, 9, 12, 13, 16

Group B: 2, 3, 6, 7, 10, 11, 14, 15

### • For any further questions about the competition, please consult dofuno1 (Asia and Oceania), Edgar and Yhoyha (Europe and Africa), Ardnew (North and South America).

*The ultimate decision-making authority for all matters mentioned above lies with the event organizing committee.*

categories.name: From Start
categories.rules:
## Timing:
The timing in this category start from the beginning of the game, on the first character movement.

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
## Category Goals:

Finish the game as fast as possible, with some restrictions regarding glitches/sequence breaks.

*If you submit a run prior to any Leaderboard changes or ruling stance changes, your run is still considered a valid submission.*

categories.name: Any% Unrestricted
categories.rules:
## Category Goals:

Reach or play the final cinematic through any means possible, without modifying the base game or using third party programs to modify the game's process memory.

- The use of 3rd party software crosshairs or crosshairs that are enabled through physical equipment on screen (i.e: monitor crosshair) are allowed.
- You *must* be playing on the most recent update / version of the game for the run to be "valid" as it will allow accuracy across the board for the game
- The use of macros are not allowed under any circumstance during your run. (Once the timer starts)
- You are allowed to remap keys (e.g. jump to scroll wheel) and remap unused game action (e.g. Ragdoll action)

# Category submission rules:

Please read and apply carefully:

- Keyboard inputs must appear at all time (at least the keys used in the game + your ragdoll key). You can use a program like NohBoard for example
- You are not allowed to use the First Person camera. The character should be visible at all possible time

*If you submit a run prior to any Leaderboard changes or ruling stance changes, your run is still considered a valid submission.*

categories.name: Bedless
categories.rules:
## Category Goals:

Finish the game as fast as possible, without the use of beds (climbing, jumping and bouncing).

There is one bed (not required, but is the new intended way). In the start of the construction site, right in front of 2 golden walls. You are allowed to use this bed, and this bed only.

*If you submit a run prior to any Leaderboard changes or ruling stance changes, your run is still considered a valid submission.*

categories.name: All Collectibles
categories.rules:
## Category Goals:

Finish the game as fast as possible while grabbing all collectibles (listed below).

Collectibles:

- Crown
- Brain
- Rose
- Heart
- Orange
- Beer
- Mask
- Flower
- The 2 Coins
- Golden Apple
- Egg

*If you submit a run prior to any Leaderboard changes or ruling stance changes, your run is still considered a valid submission.*

categories.name: Fake End%
categories.rules:
## Category Goals:

Finish by going into the "Winner!" platform. Timing stop at the first frame the player touches the platform.

## Glitches and Skips:

You are not allowed to use the "Save Progress" elevator in any of the subcategories, even if it's allowed in the general rules.

*If you submit a run prior to any Leaderboard changes or ruling stance changes, your run is still considered a valid submission.*

categories.name: Elevator%
categories.rules:
## Category Goals:

Finish by going into the first favelas red elevator. Timing stop at the first frame the elevator moves.

## Glitches and Skips:

You are allowed to use the ball to get a boost.

*If you submit a run prior to any Leaderboard changes or ruling stance changes, your run is still considered a valid submission.*

categories.name: First Person
categories.rules:
## Category Goals:

Finish the game as fast as possible in the first-person view. You must keep the first-person view throughout the whole run.

*If you submit a run prior to any Leaderboard changes or ruling stance changes, your run is still considered a valid submission.*

categories.name: Big Jump
categories.rules:
## Run

- You **are** allowed to use the Only Up! Trainer **only** to enable the "Big Jump" feature within the trainer.

- You are **not** allowed to teleport anywhere with the Only Up! Trainer once your run starts.

- You are **not** allowed to utilize LFly in this category.

- Roll Glitch is also **not** allowed in this category.

- Windmill super cut is **not** allowed.



**You can find the Only Up! Trainer in this games "Resources" section.**

values.name: True Bedless
values.rules:
# True Bedless
You can use, bounce or get projected by any platform as long as it's not a bed.

This variable rules:
- Boat Skip (Allowed)
- Dragon Launch (Allowed)
- Dino Launch (Not Allowed)

If you have any further questions regarding this category + variable, please refer to the games' rules.

values.name: No Major Skips
values.rules:
# No Major Skips
In addition to beds, the use of the first elevator, trampolines, drones, the champagne bottle, the wind turbine and the dragon is not allowed.

The boat skip (clipping into the ship and getting projected by spamming jump) is also not allowed.

Clipping through the beanstalk vines is also not allowed in this category.

If you have any further questions regarding this category + variable, please refer to the games' rules.

values.name: Dragon Route
values.rules:
# Dragon Route
You are allowed to use any part of the wing, including the tips, to get thrown off to space and above.

You are not allowed to use the Wind Turbine supercut or the Dinosaur to get projected anywhere on the map.

If you have any further questions regarding this category + variable, please refer to the games' rules.

values.name: All Skips
values.rules:
# With All Skips
You **are** allowed to utilize the Dragon, the Boat, the Dinosaur and any future tricks to help save time in this category.

If you have any further questions regarding this category + variable, please refer to the games' rules.

values.name: Launchless
values.rules:
# Without Dragon Launch
You are not allowed to use the dragon wing tip with its animation to get thrown off to the space area and above. You can still use any other part of the wing. See this picture for reference: https://imgur.com/ypvPkbQ

# Without Wind Turbine Supercut
You are not allowed to use the Wind Turbine to get thrown off anywhere above the highway.

# Without Boat Skip
You are not allowed to utilize the boat to skip the waiting period by any means in this category.

# Without Dino Launch
You are not allowed to utilize any part of the Dinosaur to vertically or horizontally launch to skip any part of the speedrun.

Note: We are talking about the inertia that the animation of the wing tip gives to the character. If you are standing on those red parts but don't use the animation, it's allowed.


If you have any further questions regarding this category + variable, please refer to the games' rules.
